title: glandularia spectabilis
intro: Glandularia spectabilis, commonly known as Rosita, is a plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia spectabilis are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
